prompt: Character Three-View Drawing. Please use the attached character image as the main reference image. Create a character three-view drawing of the same character depicted from the following three directions: 1. Front, 2. Side, 3. Back. Faithfully maintain the face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body type, skin color, outfit, accessories, and characteristic parts so that the subject can be recognized as the same person as the character in the reference image. In all three directions, draw in the same natural standing pose and at the same scale. Completely unify height, body type, hairstyle, outfit design, and the position/shape of accessories across all three directions. Use a plain white background, neutral lighting, a composition that shows the entire body, and a layout that is easy to read as character setting material. Do not include extreme perspective, dynamic poses, cut-off body parts, different characters, text, or unnecessary background elements. High-quality anime character design, delicate line art, unified proportions, easy-to-read setting material, and front/side/back turnaround.

promptZh: 角色三视图。请使用随附的角色图像作为主要参考图。创建一个与参考图中角色一致的三视图，包含以下三个方向：1. 正面，2. 侧面，3. 背面。请忠实地保持面部、发型、发色、瞳色、体型、肤色、服装、配饰及特征部位，确保主体能被识别为与参考图中的角色为同一人。在所有三个方向上，请使用相同的自然站姿和比例进行绘制。确保三个方向的高度、体型、发型、服装设计以及配饰的位置和形状完全统一。使用纯白色背景、中性光照、全身构图，并采用易于阅读的角色设定资料布局。请勿包含极端的透视、动态姿势、身体部位缺失、其他角色、文字或不必要的背景元素。高质量动漫角色设计，精致的线条，统一的比例，易于阅读的设定资料，以及正面/侧面/背面三视图。
